title: Vijnana Aranya, Mathru Mandali and IIET, Mysuru
location: Mathru Mandali Vidya Samsthe and IIET, Mysuru
teaser: Vijnana Aranya at two Mysuru venues: "Need for Self-Awareness for Teachers" by H.L. Satheesh (Mathru Mandali), and "Music & Science in Concert" by M.K. Shankar (IIET).
homepageMatter: On 24 January 2026, tAcT conducted a Vijnana Aranya at two venues in Mysuru. H.L. Satheesh spoke on self-awareness for teachers at Mathru Mandali Vidya Samsthe, and M.K. Shankar presented an evening concert exploring music and science at the Indian Institute of Educational Theatre.
